notes.title: Mod Update - 0.8.0
notes.content:
Hello, this is Team Offbeat.

We’re excited to announce the release of VR Mode!

[h1]VR Mode[/h1]
You can now experience SOUNDSCAPE in VR. This allows for a more immersive experience, with several systems optimized for VR gameplay.
When you wear the VR headset and launch the app, it will automatically start in VR mode.

[h2]Changes in the System[/h2]
[list]
[*] Instead of simply right-clicking, using the white cane now involves physically swinging it in space.
[*] The braille system has been simplified.
[/list]


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where tutorial text was displayed incorrectly.
[/list]

notes.title: 콘텐츠 업데이트 - 0.7.0
notes.content:
Hello, this is Team Offbeat.

The additional stage update originally scheduled for February 7 has been completed earlier than expected, so we’re releasing it three days ahead of schedule!

[h1]Content Update - Maegyo station[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45305139/714256e65831e250f7a52be3e4c2cc713a8246f9.png[/img]
[b]Maegyo Station[/b] has been added. This stage features more exits and a larger space than previous subway stations, making it a relatively high-difficulty stage.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where train arrival announcements could be heard from outside.
[*] Fixed an issue where volume settings were not applied to certain sounds.
[*] Fixed a problem where the visualization of the voice guidance device appeared too small.
[*] Fixed an issue where setting the volume to 0 would instead apply the maximum value.
[*] Fixed overlapping in-game UI elements.
[*] Refined quest descriptions for better clarity.
[*] Fixed areas where players could pass through walls.
[*] Unified the design of the Braille Interpreter UI.
[*] Fixed incorrect information appearing on the Braille Interpreter.
[*] Fixed an issue where elevator buttons would disappear after Braille interpretation.
[/list]

If you encounter any bugs, have feedback, or have any inquiries, please contact us at teamoffb2t@gmail.com. Your feedback is invaluable in improving SOUNDSCAPE!

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Announcement: Game Launch Date and Future Plans
notes.content:
SOUNDSCAPE is almost here!

SOUNDSCAPE is set to launch [b]on January 31st at 00:00 KST[/b].

The launch build will include the following content:
[list]
[*]A dedicated tutorial stage
[*]Stages for Cheonggyesan Station and Bojeong Station
[/list]

[h1]Future Development Plans[/h1]

We are currently developing [b]Maegyo Station[/b] as an additional stage, which will be introduced with the first update after the official launch! Maegyo Station will be larger and more complex compared to the Cheonggyesan and Bojeong stages.

The first update is scheduled for [b]February 7th[/b].

We are also working on a [b]VR mode[/b]. While our original plan was to include it in the launch build, technical issues have delayed its release. We are aiming to release the VR mode within February!

Thank you so much for your interest in our game. We look forward to seeing you soon with the official build!
